prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 1 双图组合题 / 论文多指标联合分析段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写双图题（如一张图是算力投入/研发经费变化，另一张图是模型误差/碳排放强度变化）的综合关联段，阐明两张图之间的内在协同或背离关系。”。请严格按照 `BP28` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L028`（诊断与修复逻辑跳跃（Bridging Logical Leaps / Missing Premises）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Chart 1 shows R&D spending and Chart 2 shows defect rates. When R&D spending goes up, defect rates go down. Country Z spends little money but has low defect rates.
structural_constraints: S1 [双图联动锚定 Cross-Chart Link]：Synthesizing both charts reveals a clear inverse / positive relationship between [Chart 1 Variable] and [Chart 2 Variable] up to [Threshold Point].
S2 [区间 1 协同变化 Phase 1 Co-movement]：Specifically, as [Variable X in Chart 1] expanded from [A] to [B] during [Period 1], [Variable Y in Chart 2] dropped correspondingly by [C%].

S3 [区间 2 边际递减/背离 Diminishing Returns / Divergence]：However, beyond [Threshold Point], although [Variable X] continued to double, [Variable Y] plateaued around [Value], indicating diminishing marginal returns.
S4 [例外个体点拨 Exception Highlight]：An exception to this pattern is [Entity Z], which achieved the lowest [Variable Y] despite maintaining moderate [Variable X].

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

domain_context: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.
structural_constraints: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：AI_Mini_Paper 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT04 (具身智能视觉-力触觉闭环操作与 Sim-to-Real 自适应完整小论文（TacFlow: Contact-Aware Visuomotor Policy）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP08 -> BP01 -> BP03`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Chart 1 shows R&D spending and Chart 2 shows defect rates. When R&D spending goes up, defect rates go down. Country Z spends little money but has low defect rates.
structural_constraints: S1 [双图联动锚定 Cross-Chart Link]：Synthesizing both charts reveals a clear inverse / positive relationship between [Chart 1 Variable] and [Chart 2 Variable] up to [Threshold Point].
S2 [区间 1 协同变化 Phase 1 Co-movement]：Specifically, as [Variable X in Chart 1] expanded from [A] to [B] during [Period 1], [Variable Y in Chart 2] dropped correspondingly by [C%].

S3 [区间 2 边际递减/背离 Diminishing Returns / Divergence]：However, beyond [Threshold Point], although [Variable X] continued to double, [Variable Y] plateaued around [Value], indicating diminishing marginal returns.
S4 [例外个体点拨 Exception Highlight]：An exception to this pattern is [Entity Z], which achieved the lowest [Variable Y] despite maintaining moderate [Variable X].
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段
domain_context: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP29` 与全文样板 `FT04` 的后半部分（`BP05 -> BP07 -> BP11`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.
structural_constraints: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
